Maintenance of the protobuf specification, including protocol compatibility, versioning, and documentation

Community support including issue triage, review of external contributions, ecosystem-feedback-driven enhancements, and public communication

request.recipient: 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stake1784sdxt6jjennmstphgdu7l7c2scf5d02a6cve2dgn5s2kq5u3j9v
request.what: Fund UTxO RPC by TxPipe: Maintaining Cardano's Integration Standard, Year 2, including part-time maintenance over 12 months and Intersect administration.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 540,750 ADA total, consisting of 525,000 ADA for UTxO RPC maintenance and enhancement plus a 15,750 ADA Intersect budget administration fee.
The motivation states the vendor funding includes 420,000 ADA plus a 105,000 ADA contingency reserve for a part-time UTxO RPC maintainer over 12 months at an annual rate of $105,000 USD.
UTxO RPC is described as an open interface specification using Protocol Buffers with SDKs in Rust, Go, Node.js, .NET, Haskell, and Python for UTxO-based blockchain integration.
The proposal asserts that Amaru, Dingo, and the Haskell Cardano node have adopted UTxO RPC as a query interface, validating it as an ecosystem standard.
The proposal states the project maintains more than 10 repositories and is fully open-source under Apache 2.0.

The proposal states it achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and provides references to voting, documentation, audited results, and audit materials.
The proposal asserts that the requested withdrawal does not, alone or in aggregate at submission, breach the applicable 350M ADA Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713.
The proposal states TxPipe has received funding through 30 Project Catalyst proposals from Funds 9 through 14, with 26 successfully delivered and 4 under development and on schedule.
The proposal states prior Intersect 2025 open-source maintenance funding for Pallas, Dolos, and UTxO RPC is being delivered on schedule.

Intersect plans to manage funds using Sundae Labs treasury management smart contracts with a Treasury Reserve Smart Contract, a Project-Specific Smart Contract, named addresses, role-based multisignature permissions, external oversight entities, and a public dashboard.

summary: The document describes a 540,750 ADA treasury withdrawal for one year of UTxO RPC maintenance by TxPipe, administered by Intersect through smart-contract-controlled treasury tooling, with several governance and adoption claims but limited in-document budget, feasibility, risk, alternatives, and failure-mode analysis.
